dishes.name: Bremer Kükenragout
dishes.desc: Creamy ragout of chicken, mushrooms, asparagus and meatballs in a light sauce, served in a puff pastry shell. Bremen's festive dish.

dishes.name: Bremer Klaben
dishes.desc: Dense fruit bread with raisins and candied peel, baked around Christmas and found in Bremen bakeries from autumn.

dishes.name: Bremer Kluten
dishes.desc: Chocolate-coated peppermint sweets, a traditional Bremen confection hardened into a ball shape.

dishes.name: Knipp
dishes.desc: Fried sausage of oats, groats and pork, served with fried potatoes and pickles. A north German speciality typical of Bremen.

dishes.name: Vegesacker Matjes
dishes.desc: Young salted herring tied to the port of Bremen-Vegesack, where the herring fleet sailed. Eaten with onions and bread.
